item.title: Divinum
item.description:
Title: Divinum
Genre: Action , Adventure , Indie , RPG
Developer: Sigil Games
Publisher: Sigil Games
Release Date: Aug 28, 2026




About This Game

An outside threat reaches your homeland, a quiet northern island. You play as Fjør, a young warrior among those born under the Fate of the Guardian, blessed with exceptional combat prowess. But that alone is not enough to defeat the invaders and protect what's sacred to your people.

Walking the path of a Warden, explore the island above and below the surface: forgotten caves and ominous forests, gloomy catacombs and sacred ruins, where you shall fight hordes of monsters, discover well-hidden secrets and harness ancestral legacy.

Intricate Combat System

Inspired by the best of the hack-and-slash genre, Divinum has a wide range of options to master and experiment with. Launch enemies into the air, where they are unable to act or escape while Fjør gains access to unique moves. Unleash unstoppable combos with two distinct primary weapons and special skills. Leave your foes no chance with quick dodges, blocks, and parries.

Impactful Collectible Equipment

Explore the world, look for secrets and fight bosses to find Runes that meaningfully change how you fight. A +5% damage item? You won't find anything this boring in Divinum. Runes can provide anything from solid unique bonuses to modifiers that can completely change how you approach battles — but great power often comes with trade-offs.

Test Your Skills and Be Rewarded

Across the island, dangerous trials and ancient evil await you. Conquer them all and claim generous rewards!

item.title: Big Ambitions
item.description:
Title: Big Ambitions
Genre: Indie , Simulation
Developer: Hovgaard Games
Publisher: Hovgaard Games
Release Date: Aug 28, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Mar 10, 2023




About This Game

Your bank balance is tiny, but your ambitions are big.

With a little help from your uncle, you get an apartment and your first job. But then it's up to you to achieve success and take over New York City any way you like.

Slowly build multiple small businesses, grow them into huge corporations, or carve your own unique path – the possibilities are limitless in this vast business sandbox. You've never played anything like this!

Go from a small apartment and public transport to luxury suites, fast cars and designer furniture. Put your money into investment funds and real estate. Succeed, fail, rebuild. But remember to take care of yourself, sleep and stay happy on your rise to the top.

Do you have what it takes to build your own empire?

Go from nothing to the most prominent tycoon in New York. Start a business, work smart, make it thrive and enjoy your life. How do you want to be successful? How far can you push it? How long can you make it last?

Start your own gift shop, supermarket, coffee shop, law firm, clothing store, liquor store, florist, and more. You decide what success is - whether it’s a single shop, a chain of fast-food restaurants, a huge corporation, or making millions developing websites.

Take out a loan, rent a building, design the logo, renovate the store, get stock, manage your money, hire staff, and build your infrastructure. Soon, you may have to start importing products from the harbour and distributing them through a network of warehouses.

A bigger business means managers. Hire HR Managers, Logistics Managers, and Purchasing Agents. They all need desks and computers, so you’ll need a fancy headquarters.

Need a delivery truck? Travel to a dealer and buy one. Need food? Go to a supermarket, but make sure you have a refrigerator at home. Big Ambitions is a life sim where your character has to physically interact with the world to survive and succeed.

Enter any building in New York and buy it. Go from a small apartment to a dream penthouse in midtown, a luxurious townhouse in Hell’s Kitchen, or a series of skyscrapers. Fill each with furniture that suits your style and standing. Invest your hard-earned cash in real estate to grow your empire. Take over the city piece by piece.

Spend your wealth however you wish. Buy a big SUV, a speedy sports car, or the new luxurious Mersaidi S500. Maybe risk it all at the casinos or put your money into investment funds and reap the rewards.

As you progress, you always need to ensure you get enough sleep and stay healthy and happy. Enjoy the journey, for as you grow older, you’ll discover that money can’t buy you time... or can it?

Big Ambitions takes what you love about the viral sensation ‘Startup Company’ to even greater heights.

item.title: House 2
item.description:
Title: House 2
Genre: Action , Adventure , Indie
Developer: Bark Bark Games
Publisher: Glowstick Entertainment
Franchise: House
Release Date: Aug 28, 2026




About This Game

As a terrible storm rages on, Tabby finds herself once again trapped in a never-ending nightmare. Uncover the mystery of the curse or succumb to it in the sequel to the 2020 horror game, House.

Featuring:

  • Explore a house that changes and reacts to your actions in real-time

  • Experiment with different items to try and survive

  • Challenging, non-linear gameplay with multiple endings

  • Play retro games on the BarkStation

  • Die in gruesomely elaborate ways in a hand-drawn story book artstyle

  • Race against the clock to try and escape a deadly time-loop

  • Save or slay your family, the choice is yours...Or is it?

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

House 2 frequently depicts graphic scenes of cartoon violence and gore during player deaths.



System Requirements

Windows

* Starting January 1st, 2024, the Steam Client will only support Windows 10 and later versions.
    Minimum:
    • OS *: Windows 7 64-bit, Windows 8.1, Windows 10, or Windows 11
    • Processor: 2.0 GHz Dual Core Processor or equivalent
    • Memory: 2 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA since 2006 (GeForce 8), AMD since 2006 (Radeon HD 2000), Intel since 2012 (HD 4000 / IvyBridge)
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 5 GB available space
    • Sound Card: Must support the ASIO audio device interface for multi-channel recording / playback, or support WDM (Windows Driver Model) audio.
    Recommended:
    • OS *: Windows 7 64-bit, Windows 8.1, Windows 10, or Windows 11
    • Processor: Intel Corei5-6600K/ AMD Ryzen 5 1600
    • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1060 3GB/ AMD Radeon RX 580 4GB
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 5 GB available space
    • Sound Card: Must support the ASIO audio device interface for multi-channel recording / playback, or support WDM (Windows Driver Model) audio.

item.title: Garden of Witches
item.description:
Title: Garden of Witches
Genre: Action , Indie , RPG
Developer: Team Tapas
Publisher: Team Tapas
Release Date: Aug 28, 2026
Early Access Release Date: May 23, 2025




About This Game

Garden of Witches is a fast-paced action roguelike where you wield giant scissors and use witchcraft to bring down other witches in the Garden. You’ll need to master enemy attack patterns, create powerful builds, and fight to bring together all the witches before the Garden falls apart.

Beat Witches into Submission

As the Thread Witch, you need to gather all the witches for an annual tea party ritual, but they aren’t going to attend the tea party willingly. Face distinct bosses with their own personalities, transformations, and attack patterns. Learn how each one fights, and find the opening you need to beat them into submission.

Unleash Your Choice of Witchcraft

Choose your favorite Scissors, Spells, and Special Skills from your Armory and personalize how you fight to save the Garden. While going through the Garden, you will be able to strengthen the abilities you love with Imprints and Relics and reshape how familiar skills behave from run to run.

Bond with Your Coven

Explore a hand-drawn world of mesmerizing witchcraft and wayward witches, each with their own unique domain. Get to know them through the game’s main five-chapter story arc and continue your journey through a three-part epilogue arc.

Japanese Voice Cast

Defy Death and Return Stronger

A witch’s death does not end their story. Return stronger with permanent upgrades and knowledge of your past runs. Then experiment with other Spells and refine your favorite builds while pushing your mastery of witchcraft. Once you reach the peak, put your craft to the test by customizing the difficulty of the Garden.

Round up the witches. Save the Garden.

And try not to get yourself killed along the way, even witches don’t like dying too much.

    • Storage: 4 GB available space
